responsive.breakpoint: mobile-first — design for mobile viewports (375px+) first, expanding seamlessly to tablet (768px) and desktop (1024px+)
responsive.layout: Single column vertical stack on mobile; side-by-side split screen (document viewer on left, PII detection panel on right) on desktop (lg:grid-cols-12); collapsible drawer for side panel on mobile devices
responsive.typography: Mobile-first scale using rem units (H1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl, Body: text-base sm:text-sm, Inputs/Buttons: min 16px font size to prevent mobile iOS zoom)
responsive.overflow_guard: Enforce max-w-full and overflow-x-hidden on outer containers; document canvas uses pinch/scroll-area with explicit max-h-[70vh] on mobile
responsive.tap_targets: All buttons, PII toggle items, and category filters must have a minimum touch target height of 44px on touch devices

instructions_to_main_agent: Build MedAnon Local as a Swiss-medical grade, ultra-trustworthy, local-first web application for gynecologists and physicians. Prioritize extreme visual calm, clean Swiss typography, generous spacing, precise PII highlighting, and responsive mobile-first accessibility. Follow the 5 core screen flows: Home (3 main action cards), Local OCR Processing Progress, Interactive Review (Document viewer + PII side panel with category filters & manual redaction tool), Before/After Anonymization Preview (Suppression vs Pseudonymisation), and Export Checklist + Download/Copy options. Ensure data-testid attributes are added to all interactive elements.

project_metadata.target_audience: Swiss Gynecologists, Obstetricians, Physicians & Healthcare Administrative Staff
project_metadata.design_archetype: Swiss Medical Precision & High-Trust Calm (Off-white paper, deep navy slate, muted alpine sage accents)
project_metadata.primary_language: FR (Français) with dynamic language switcher to DE (Deutsch), IT (Italiano), and EN (English)

hierarchy.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[#0F1E36]

layouts.header_bar: flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-8 py-3 bg-[#FFFFFF]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E5E0D8] sticky top-0 z-50
layouts.privacy_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-[#ECFDF5] text-[#065F46] border border-[#6EE7B7] hover:bg-[#D1FAE5] cursor-pointer transition-colors

accessibility.contrast_target: APCA 75+ / WCAG AA compliant. All body text on off-white bg has a minimum contrast ratio of 7:1

3d_libraries.note: 3D graphics are explicitly disabled for MedAnon Local to ensure medical seriousness, instant WASM local loading speed, and zero clinical distraction.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.component_reuse: Use shadcn primitives in /src/components/ui/ (Button, Dialog, Checkbox, Tabs, DropdownMenu, Sheet, Badge, Switch, Progress, Toast) with custom styling applied via Tailwind.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react icons exclusively. No emoji UI icons except the single 🔒 lock symbol inside privacy badges.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner (/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx) for user feedback toasts (e.g. 'Document anonymisé avec succès', 'Texte copié dans le presse-papier').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.privacy_guarantee_modal: Provide an informative modal explaining local WASM processing (Tesseract.js OCR, local regex & NER patterns) with zero network requests.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: Add testid attributes in kebab-case to all action buttons, input triggers, category filters, and document controls.
